heroHeadline: Day 85: El Sapo Hunt Day 85 — No Capture; Plan Kukulkan Final 24-Day Phase; Manzanillo Command Void; CJNG Succession Binary Holds
heroSubtitle: Day 85 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 85: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target (named May 3, 2026). No confirmed capture or elimination reported through Day 85. CJNG's military chief maintains operational continuity across Jalisco, Michoacán, Puebla, and Zacatecas corridors, with a personal security detail including former Mexican Army, Marines, and Colombian and Guatemalan former combatants. PLAN KUKULKAN — 24 DAYS: Twenty-four days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11). Mexico's 111,000+ security deployment has entered its final operational preparation phase, with Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 group-stage matches) under particular CJNG-specific security protocols. The continued absence of El Sapo's capture is the primary unresolved security risk for Plan Kukulkan. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 9: Nine days since the arrest of Lorenzo Sánchez 'El Chucky' (May 9), the CJNG plaza boss for the Port of Manzanillo. No publicly identified successor named; port operating under heightened Navy-SEMAR surveillance with CJNG's embedded port relationships structurally intact. CJNG CHILE TRIAL (May 17): Chilean prosecutors seeking 35-year sentences for two CJNG Mexican nationals who established a clandestine methamphetamine production hub in Chile — producing 844 kilograms of meth for Australian distribution — documenting cartel transnational manufacturing resilience that transcends El Mencho's death. EL JARDINERO STATUS — EXTRADITION BLOCKED: Audias Flores Silva 'El Jardinero' (arrested April 27) in Altiplano maximum security prison; U.S. extradition suspended (May 15 Mexican federal tribunal ratification), DOJ superseding indictment (May 14) unenforceable until Mexican proceedings conclude. EL SAPO as sole surviving senior anti-O3 faction leader at large — the El 03 (financial wing, confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large) succession binary is Mexico's defining CJNG enforcement challenge. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 85): FGR's criminal investigation of Chihuahua Fiscalía for federal jurisdiction invasion and possible treason continues. QUINTUPLE BILATERAL PRESSURE TRACK at maximum stress: CIAgate FGR investigation + DOJ Rocha Moya departure + 'irrefutable proof' extradition standard + State Dept consulate review + ongoing CJNG interdiction. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 85: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized. ACLED (May 12): zero organizational fracture, 'tactical containment,' CJNG reinforcing Michoacán alliances with Los Viagras.
